why: Stops failing a control the player cannot scroll to. Raising every menu control to 44 px makes each pane taller -- Versus Setup under Teams has 44 controls -- and the acceptance criterion is that primary actions stay reachable. A floor that pushed Start past the end of its scroll container would satisfy every size check and leave the pane unusable.
